summary: Constellation Brands filed an 8-K disclosing two routine debt capital markets activities: (1) notice of full redemption of its outstanding 3.700% Senior Notes due 2026, a standard pre-maturity liability management action, and (2) issuance of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 4.850% Senior Notes due 2031 at a public offering price of 99.943% of par, under an existing shelf registration statement. Interest is payable semi-annually commencing November 6, 2026. The notes contain customary redemption provisions and events of default. No special situation is involved as these are ordinary refinancing and new-debt offerings, not a takeover, restructuring, or other event-driven category. No deal terms requiring a separate object.
